Sweet & Friendly Dog Still Searching For Love After Owner Went Into Hospice Care
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently shared that Coco, a sweet six-year-old Shih Tzu and Poodle mix weighing 25 pounds, is still looking for his forever family. Coco’s rescue story started with a bittersweet transition when his previous owner, unfortunately, entered hospice care. In addition to finding himself in need of a new home, Coco’s fur was severely matted at that time. Luckily, Sandy Paw Rescue Inc. was there to give him the shave he needed and connected him with a loving foster home. According to the Rescue, it has now been over a month, and “Coco is still waiting for an application!”

Meet The Friendly Dog Who "Loves Everyone She Meets" Looking For Her Forever Family
The Scituate Animal Shelter of Massachusetts recently introduced a 4-year-old female dog named Molly who is looking for her forever family. "While Molly may not be the best girl in the world, she sure is in the running for that title," the shelter shares with enthusiasm about this mixed breed dog with a unique personality. Weighing in at a 17 pounds, Molly brings an infectious energy and adventurous spirit to everything she does. Her friendly disposition knows no bounds, as the shelter notes, "She loves everyone she meets, humans of all ages." This sociable nature makes her an ideal companion for active families, with the shelter suggesting she would be "great to bring to soccer games on weekends and family hikes."

Young Dog Still Searching For Home After Original Owners Refused To Neuter Him
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently reported that Nixon, a remarkable young dog with a difficult past, is still searching for his forever home after over five months. Nixon’s story began when he was found wandering the streets of Texas at around one year of age. When his owners were contacted to come get him, they learned that per the city ordinance, they were required to have him neutered. They reportedly responded, “You can keep him, we only got him to breed,” and effectively abandoned him. Luckily, Sandy Paws Rescue Inc. stepped in to save Nixon from becoming another statistic. Since entering their care, Nixon has spent some time in a board-and-train program in Texas and is now living with a foster family in Massachusetts.

Local Shelter Introduces "The Most Adorable Little Gremlins" Looking For Love
The Scituate Animal Shelter of Massachusetts recently introduced an adorable bonded pair of Chihuahua mixes, Gonzo and Sugar, who are seeking their forever home together. "The most adorable little gremlins we've ever seen," the shelter enthusiastically shared about the duo, explaining they're "the good kind of Chihuahuas that don't bite you ankles!" These small companions have captured hearts with their gentle dispositions, and are hoping their future forever family finds them soon!

Sweet & Shy Puppy Found Abandoned Still Looking For Love After 3 Months
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently explained to their community that Bree, a young shepherd mix puppy, is still waiting for an adoption application after over three months. Originally discovered in a Houston park alongside her three sisters, Bambi, Bailey, and Bridget, Bree's life took a fortunate turn when a Sandy Paws Rescue volunteer found them. Once rescued, she was swiftly placed in foster care, where over the past few months she has blossomed. "She has graduated from wanting to hang in her crate to willingly joining her foster family on the couch," shares her foster family, highlighting the remarkable progress in her confidence.

Meet The Tiny 6lb Puppy With Unique Needs Who is Searching For Love
Great Dog Rescue New England, a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, would like you to meet a sweet little dog named Porter. This tiny 8-week-old Australian Shepherd mix, weighing in at a mere 6.5lbs, is in search of a patient and loving forever family. While there are countless dogs in rescue care looking for their second chances, Porter comes with a disadvantage that might make it even harder to get that chance. Due to a double merle genetic defect, Porter is blind and will need a patient family that can help him with more specialized training.

Meet The Little 10lb Puppy Found Abandoned in Empty Apartment Now Looking For Love
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently introduced Izzy, a resilient puppy with a tough backstory and a heart full of love. "She was found all alone in an empty apartment when she was 6 weeks old," the rescue shares, highlighting the challenging start to Izzy's journey. Thankfully, she was found in time by a rescue volunteer who brought her into Sandy Paws Rescue Inc.’s capable hands. She has since been placed in a loving foster home, alongside her foster-sister and “bestie” Lizzy, a Yorkshire Terrier mix puppy who was also abandoned in the apartment.

Meet The Adorable & Charismatic Puppy Searching For Love
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently introduced their newest resident, Barack, a charismatic puppy who is waiting for his forever family to find him and bring him home! Due to his name, this lovable pup has earned the endearing nickname "Mr. President" among his caretakers. Barack's journey at the shelter has been marked by equal parts charm and playful mischief. This was perfectly demonstrated in a memorable incident involving a bathroom sink and his own reflection. "Barack wanted to get a closer look at the mirror-puppy, because he looked so handsome. This resulted in two handsome puppies in a too-small sink," the shelter shared with amusement.
